text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day finally arrived to give the progress report presentation
in front of the other trainers.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for the Trainer Regular Report Meeting.
I am looking forward to hearing your talk,
<username> Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've built up my preparations step by step, just like I learned from weight training.
Even if it doesn't match the senior trainers... I'll give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: S-So... how did the presentation go...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Really?! It went well!
Ahhh, what a relief...!
choice_data_list: I invited you out today to thank you for that.
I invited you today as a thank-you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to thank me! I didn't do
anything special at all...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Besides... it didn't feel like someone else's problem,
so I just meddled of my own accord.
choice_data_list: What do you mean, not someone else's problem...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Um, how do I put it...
It kind of overlapped with how I used to be...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was little, I've loved moving my body.
At first, muscle training was just part of that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But one day—my aunt told me,
"Ryan, the way your muscles develop
is truly suited for running."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I always thought I was totally ordinary
among the Mejiro family, so...
To know there was something about me that could be praised—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That was my strength.
So I decided to hone my own unique strength, my weapon!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, I pushed myself
in muscle training harder than ever before, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I should be able to lift this much...!
More... I have to train more...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
One day, I hit a wall...
and I completely panicked.
I threw myself recklessly into training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
To the point where I was cutting back on sleep...
In the end, everyone stepped in to stop me... And then—

text_block_list.name: Grandmother of the Mejiro Family
text_block_list.text:
I heard from Ardan.
It seems you have been pushing yourself too hard lately.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm not overdoing it...!
It's all so I can become stronger—

text_block_list.name: Grandmother of the Mejiro Family
text_block_list.text: A journey of a thousand miles cannot be completed in a single stride.

text_block_list.name: Grandmother of the Mejiro Family
text_block_list.text: That holds true even for... McQueen, or Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Grandmother of the Mejiro Family
text_block_list.text: Ryan... At times, you must cherish each small step.

text_block_list.name: Grandmother of the Mejiro Family
text_block_list.text:
No matter what kind of step it may be,
the fact remains that you are moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Grandmother of the Mejiro Family
text_block_list.text: In fact, the weight on your barbell has increased compared to last year, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Grandmother of the Mejiro Family
text_block_list.text:
You have embodied that progress.
Therefore, everyone holds great expectations. Never forget that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone tends to focus only on big changes or flashy successes, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But what's truly important is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes! As long as you keep taking even just a single small step forward, there's nothing you can't achieve!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So after all, the thing that helps you realize that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Muscle training is truly magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Is it? Sure, she gained that realization through muscle training, but—
choice_data_list: Muscle training is the only way!
Muscle training is the only way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Is it? Sure, she gained that realization through muscle training, but—
choice_data_list: Muscle training is the only way!
Muscle training is the only way!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ehh?! Presentation skills...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: No, no, I'm really bad at that kind of stuff! Standing in front of people, speaking logically, all of it...!
choice_data_list: Holding a muscle training seminar sounds like a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...!!
A muscle training... seminar...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I might actually want to try that...
...Would you practice the presentation with me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later, I ended up accompanying her on a workout under the guise of "practice," deepening my understanding of muscle training even further.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ohh! I knew you'd understand, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Actually, I've already prepared a workout routine just for you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: When I watched your workout before, I designed a routine based on your habits and the muscle groups you frequently use!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Last time was focused on your upper body, so this routine is centered on your lower body, especially the thighs—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, she gave a passionate, lengthy lecture about the routine she had devised.
